title: The best help
body: Finch helps me get in line with my responsibilities without even realising it. It has also helped me to build new healthy habits. Thanks Finch!
author: ur.ny

title: My Honest Review
body: Finch has been like a bestfried to me, especially my self care pet, her name is Star. She makes me so happy with the random daily interactions, this app is the best selfcare app anyone could ever get. It also help me balance my emotions and helps calm my anxiety levels, I recommend it for all age groups and gender too.
author: JamesAdah

title: The best app ever!
body: I am really glad that this app has no leaderboard to stress you up like other apps do and it has a lot of activities and I just love the animations, graphics and design
author: Jhilmil13

title: More interactive please
body: I honestly love this app, but I would love for it to be more interactive and exciting

title: Lovely
body: I talk so much about my mental issues , very friendly for those in lgbtq community and it’s lovely . Helps remind you to take care of yourself .
author: dotylo

title: Amazing Experience!
body: Finch has helped me journal everyday and it’s gradually becoming a habit. I love that the app isn’t built to trap you in, but to help you navigate life and manage your emotions. I’ll keep using it. Thanks for building this, it’s such a great app!
